name: cell-fused
description: csdid 1.81/2.0.1 rules with every option of the combined task: cell list and aggregation weights from cell sizes (cohort tallies on balanced panels); per-cohort Newton fits (logit, tilting, csdid 2.0.1's overlap logit, weighted least squares) shared across cells with identical units and covariates, with hoisted sums, and warm-started otherwise; one fused Numba pass over units for every cell's influence function and every aggregate (no n_units x n_cells matrices); multiplier bootstrap by member-aware BLAS products per cohort chunk, aggregate draws derived from cell draws, quickselect order statistics; exact reference operations for singular, boundary or degenerate cells. Threads: NUMBA_NUM_THREADS and BLAS, in separate phases.
